goal: Let applications attach logging connections to specific kernel contexts with per-connection log levels
Prevents breaking API churn for downstream users before per-context log routing is introduced
agreement: Concept approval for making the kernel logging interface local rather than global (sedited, stickies-v)
Approach NACK against adding the public interface before internal changes land in #30342 (stickies-v)
Objection: setting levels per connection misleads users while behavior remains global (stringintech)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it avoids breaking API changes for downstream consumers before more code depends on it
Unblocks per-context log separation without forcing call-site refactors later
